business_goal: Allow team members to discuss a task in context by adding comments, so work-related conversations stay attached to the task instead of scattered across email or chat.
scope: Allow users to add text comments to tasks they have access to
Allow users to view all comments on a task in chronological order
Allow users to delete their own comments
Record and display comment author and timestamp

functional_requirements.description: A user can add a text comment to a task they have access to
A user can view all comments on a task in chronological order
A user can delete their own comment
The system must record who posted each comment and when

non_functional_requirements.description: Comments should load quickly even when a task has many comments
The comment list should update without a full page reload
The system must ensure that comment lists update in real-time, even when multiple users are commenting on the same task simultaneously.

user_stories.goal: To discuss a task with colleagues in context
user_stories.benefit: Work-related conversations stay attached to the task instead of being scattered

user_stories.goal: To monitor team discussions on tasks
user_stories.benefit: Ensure transparency and accountability in task execution

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a task the user can access, when they submit a non-empty comment, the comment appears in the task's comment list with the author's name and timestamp.
Given a comment the user authored, when they choose delete, the comment is removed from the list.
Given a comment the user authored, when they choose delete, the system must confirm with the user before permanently removing the comment from the list.
acceptance_criteria.original_description: Given a comment authored by someone else, the user must not see a delete option for it.

output_requirements: List of comments with author name and timestamp
Confirmation of successful comment creation or deletion
ui_expectations: A comment input box at the bottom of the task detail view
A scrollable list of existing comments, newest last
A delete icon shown only on the current user's own comments

validation_rules.description: Comment text must not be empty
Only the author of a comment can delete it

constraints: Reuse the existing authenticated user/session for identifying the comment author
assumptions: Tasks and user accounts already exist in the system
Only authenticated team members with access to a task can view or post comments on it
The system supports real-time updates for comment lists
User sessions are securely managed and validated
risks: Performance degradation with a large number of comments
Security risk if unauthorized users can delete comments
dependencies: API gateway for task and comment endpoints
